inputs.text: With tensions escalating in the Middle East, the US has proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran through Pakistan. Iran responded with five counter-conditions, including an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of its sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Israel remains sceptical that Iran will accept the plan and has stressed its right to pre-emptive strikes, underscoring the complex demands involved in efforts to end the ongoing conflict.
